P. (कुटति, कुटित) 
__1 To be crooked or curved. 
__2 To curve or bend. 3 To act dishonestly, cheat, deceive. --
P. (कुट्यति) To break to pieces, break asunder, divide, split; [[

.]] 
__2 To speak indistinctly. 
__3 To be warm, burn.

€10U. (कुट्टयति, कुट्टित) 
__1 To cut, divide. 
__2 To grind, pound. 
__3 To blame, censure. 
__4 To multiply. 
__5 To burn.

Ā. (कूटयते, कूटित) 
__1 To abstain from giving; not to give. 
__2 To censure. --

U. 
__1 To burn. 
__2 To call, invite. 
__3 To render confused, to muddle. 
__4 To be distressed. 
__5 To despair. 
__6 To counsel, advise.
